sources: Esri World_Imagery around the site points

values.note: 35 sites: 17 take RVs, 18 are tent-only. The FS caps total RV length at 35 ft, but most RV sites are catalogued at 15-20 ft; only six take 23 ft or more: 004 (30 ft), 006 (25), 016 (26, pull-through) and 024 (25), reservable, and 030 (35) and 032 (30, pull-through), first-come. 017 is a 20-ft pull-through.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/amphitheater-campground-ouray-rd ('35 camping spurs'; 'best suited for tent camping and smaller trailers/RVs (RVs can park at sites 3 through 15 ...). Total RV length should not exceed 35 feet.') + rec.gov per-site catalog (type, permitted equipment, Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Trash collection; picnic table and fire ring at each site.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/amphitheater-campground-ouray-rd ('Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is available at this site') + https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232275 ('Vault toilets, drinking water and trash collection are provided'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: rec.gov: opening and closing dates are weather permitting.

Reservable sites book on recreation.gov for the peak season (2026: May 31 - Sep 12; 2027: May 28 - Sep 12); the shoulder weeks (2026: May 17-30 and Sep 13-30) are first-come only. First-come sites must be claimed in person ('DO NOT call to determine availability'). recreation.gov closes booking 3 days before arrival (reservationCutOff 3). 7 consecutive nights maximum; 2-night weekend minimum on reservations. One camping unit per site; extra vehicles are paid to the host on arrival. Run by a concessionaire (contact 928-537-8888).

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232275 (facility_rules maxConsecutiveStay 7, minWeekendStay 2 (not marked soft), reservationCutOff 3; notices 'FIRST COME FIRST SERVE sites must be booked in person', 'Opening and closing dates are weather permitting, please call 928-537-8888') + /rates (2026 Peak Season 2026-05-31 to 2026-09-12; First-come, First-served Season 2026-05-17 to 05-30 and 2026-09-13 to 09-30; 2027 Peak 2027-05-28 to 09-12) + FS page ('a combination of first come, first serve and reservable campsites'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: $28 a night per camping unit, every site type, reservable or first-come; extra vehicle $14 a night (FS).

fees.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/232275/rates (2026 Peak and First-come seasons: RV/STANDARD/TENT ONLY NONELECTRIC 28) + https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/recreation/amphitheater-campground-ouray-rd ('Single Site: $28 per night; Extra Vehicle Fee: $14 per night'), read 2026-10-28

note: USFS campground at ~8,400 ft on a steep hillside above Ouray off US-550, among Gambel oak and mixed conifers, overlooking the town and the Amphitheater cliffs; the Upper Cascade Falls trail starts here. The FS calls it best suited to tents and smaller trailers/RVs: the access road and loops are steep with tight turns, and RVs follow the 'trailer' signs (second right). --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov (description, rates, 35-site catalog): confirmed 35 sites, max 35 ft, vault toilets/water, reservable with some first-come sites, $28 (now dated 2026). Added pull-throughs, the 6 sites that take 23 ft+, season May 23 - Oct 7 (replacing the calendar-derived close 09-12), booking.season May 31 - Sep 12, 7-night max, 2-night weekend minimum, extra-vehicle fee. Note: dropped the amenity/booking/site-count restatements and the 'sites 3-15' line the catalog contradicts.
flags: Fit: only 6 of 35 sites take a 23-ft rig per the rec.gov catalog (004 30 ft, 006 25, 016 26 PT, 024 25 reservable; 030 35, 032 30 PT first-come); the other 11 RV sites are 15-20 ft. FS: 'Total RV length should not exceed 35 feet' and 'best suited for tent camping and smaller trailers/RVs'. EKKO fits, but only those six.

Conflict on which sites take RVs: the FS page says 'RVs can park at sites 3 through 15', but rec.gov's catalog makes 007-014 tent-only and lists RV sites at 003-006, 015-025 (not 021), 030 and 032. The catalog's lengths (max 35) agree with the FS 35-ft limit.

Missing phone: the Ouray Ranger District is (970) 240-5300 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/gmug/offices). rec.gov gives the concessionaire's 928-537-8888 (camping@rrmofa.com) for opening/closing questions.
Operator: run by a concessionaire (rec.gov contact camping@rrmofa.com, 928-537-8888) on GMUG land; ownership federal is right.
Pin 38.02256,-107.66259 sits on site 020, ~70 m from the 35-site centroid. Fine. (The FS page's point, 38.02439,-107.662743, is ~200 m north at the entrance road.)

Access: no agency page gives a grade or RV advisory for the 1-mile access road beyond 'best suited for ... smaller trailers/RVs'. No 4WD advice. The Gold Mountain Fire closure order (Ouray RD) covers Dexter Creek, Cutler, Jackass Flats, Middle Fork Cimarron, Cow Creek and Blowout roads, not this campground's road.
Status: the FS page header reads 'Site Closed' on 2026-10-28, after its Oct. 7 season end - ordinary seasonal closing.
